Screenshots and live view. See an employee's screen, only when your monitoring policy allows it, and always visibly to the employee.
Open Live Tracking, then Screenshot. Choose a member and a date. The screenshots of that day appear in the gallery, by time.
Click a screenshot to see it larger. Use the arrows to move to the previous or next day.
To download a whole day, click Raise Request. Choose the member and the date, and click Raise request.
Open Download Requests. When the status shows Ready, click Download, to save a ZIP file.
For live viewing, open Live Stream. It shows who is online, active, idle or offline.
Click View live, on an online employee. The stream is peer to peer, never recorded, and every view is audited.
The employee's tray icon shows a badge while they are being viewed. The stream ends automatically, or click Stop stream.
The Session log lists every live view: who watched, the device, and how long it lasted.
